Variants.Content: Entry Located on the coast of the Narrow Sea, Myr is known for its craftsmen, merchants, and fine goods. Myr lenses help maesters and navigators see into the distance, while lace, carpets, stained glass, and finely crafted crossbows turn craftsmanship into wealth; in this city, workshops, docks, and merchant houses are closely related to nobles The citizens of Myr are accustomed to viewing war as just another expensive business: mercenaries, ships, loans, and orders for craftsmen rise and fall with city-state conflicts. It competed with and relied on Tyrosh and Lys on the Stepstone Islands and trade routes.
